parameters.name: ContainerFieldName
parameters.description:
The container field. Valid values:

- **clusterId**: cluster ID.

parameters.name: ContainerFieldValue
parameters.description: The value of the container field.

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: The source of the request. Set the value to **sas**, which indicates that the request is sent from Security Center.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: MultiAccountActionType
parameters.description:
The multi-account query type. Default value: **0**. Valid values:
- **0**: queries data of the current account.
- **1**: queries data of all accounts.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the security alerting Alarm Metric.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The IP address of the access source.

parameters.name: SupportOperateCodeList
parameters.description: The list of operation types supported by the alert.

parameters.name: Uuids
parameters.description:
The UUIDs of the servers. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,).
> Call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~141932~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
